name: GSK
headline: SELL: target GBP 1.78 vs price GBP 18.775 (-90.5% upside) on blended DCF/DDM/comps

thesis.summary: Systematic note generated from live data. Market price GBP 18.775 against a blended 12-month target of GBP 1.78 (weights {'comps_pe': 0.667, 'comps_ev_ebitda': 0.333}). Peer-median P/E of 0.3x applied to EPS of GBP 1.18 implies GBP 0.32. Reported FCF has trended down over the last 4 financial years (GBP 5,145m -> GBP 4,756m), which drives the growth path shown in the inputs table.
catalysts: Convergence toward the blended target of GBP 1.78 (-90.5%) over the 3-month review window
Next FY results: reported FCF vs the latest-FY base used in the DCF
risks: Thesis invalidation: price sustaining beyond GBP 1.78 in the opposite direction of the recommendation for 10+ sessions
Fundamentals revision: a restated or materially different latest-FY FCF/net-debt base than the frozen inputs
Rate sensitivity: the CAPM cost of equity moves with the 10Y gilt yield

dcf.wacc_source: WACC: cost of equity (CAPM) used directly; no leverage assumption introduced. beta n/a; implied pre-tax kd 4.1% disclosed only

derivation: multiples computed per peer: EV = price x shares + net debt; EV/EBITDA and P/E on latest FY, all FX-converted to GBP
EV/EBITDA leg: median 3.1x x EBITDA 10,402m - net debt 13,731m = equity 18,794m / 4,006m shares = 4.69
